title: Merge overlapping busy periods
insight: LeetCode 56 Merge Intervals: sort a copy by start, then sweep and extend the current block
prompt: Please implement MergeBusy in calendar.go for the scheduling service. README.md describes exactly how busy periods merge and what the output has to look like.
